## Glyphling 0.9.4 (test build for 1.0)

Download `Glyphling-Setup-0.9.4.exe` below and run it. It updates an existing installation in place, keeping settings, themes and position.

### Changed
- **Music apps**: the Settings > Music list now comes from the updated design. Each listed app has its own "Volume" toggle; the circle's volume lowers exactly the listed apps whose toggle is on (with an empty list, the app that is playing). Only the listed apps are shown and controlled; an empty list means any app.
- **No background refreshing**: the "Running now" chips (apps with audio, playing or not) are read from Windows only when Settings opens and when you press Refresh, never on a timer.
- The separate "Volume app" row of 0.9.3 is gone (replaced by the per-app toggles).
- Smoother circle at 2048 points: the design's cached dim-dot layer and half-resolution glow, plus 30 fps repainting at that size.

The setup is not signed yet: Windows SmartScreen may warn on first launch ("More info" → "Run anyway").
